WSH.note: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.
The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

Castleton totaled five points (2-4 FG, 1-1 3Pt) and four rebounds in seven minutes during Tuesday's 132-116 preseason win over the Cavaliers.
Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.
Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
Porter won't play Saturday against the Wizards as he's still in the process of getting up to speed on his conditioning.

Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.

BKN.note: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Wagner (knee) won't be available for Friday's game against Toronto.

CHI.note: Powell (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pacers.
Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

IND.note: Haliburton (hamstring) has been ruled out per Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com for Friday's game against the 76ers. The guard participated in practice activities earlier this week as he continues working toward his return.
McConnell (hamstring) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the 76ers, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.
Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

MIL.note: Jakucionis (ankle) won't play Friday's game against the Pistons.

Mara (leg) is out for Saturday's game versus the Bucks, per Clemente Almanza of USA Today.

Topic (hip) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.
Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
James (back injury management) won't be available for Saturday's game against the Rockets, according to Kris Rhim of ESPN.
Wade (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers, Austin Krell of Vertical 76 reports.
